# Selected cover evidence

Human selected the ChatGPT-generated B artwork on2026-10-18. The generated cover is editorial artwork. Body figures are the unchanged native source captures.

- og-before: prior built article at cdf01fd, no individual cover.
- og-after: updated branch production build. Matched1440×1000, light, locale.
- og-mobile:390×844, real light/dark controls, no horizontal overflow.
- og-index: actual article thumbnail on the built blog index.
- og-checks.json: loaded1200×630 localized cover, OG/Twitter metadata, index and source-asset hashes.
- og-regeneration-check.json: verifies preservation of the two approved images only.
- build-artwork-check.json: records the release-build refusal smoke check; scripts/blog-artwork.test.mjs covers title, hash, missing image, invalid metadata and missing article refusals through the validation command.
